deployment.succeeded.label: Deploy succeeded
deployment.succeeded.description: A deployment finished successfully and is serving traffic.

deployment.failed.label: Deploy failed
deployment.failed.description: A deployment errored out before reaching a healthy state.

deployment.cancelled.label: Deploy cancelled
deployment.cancelled.description: A deployment was stopped before it finished.

deployment.no_changes.label: No changes to deploy
deployment.no_changes.action: found no changes to deploy for
deployment.no_changes.description: A redeploy found every service already up to date, so the current release stayed live.

deployment:write.label: Deploy action
deployment:write.description: A deployment endpoint was invoked — start, retry, rollback, or promote.

deployment:admin.label: Deploy admin action
deployment:admin.action: ran an admin action on the deploy for
deployment:admin.description: A destructive deployment endpoint was invoked, such as cancel or destroy.
deployment:admin.actionWithoutResource: ran an admin action on the deploy

project.updated.label: App updated
project.updated.description: Settings, services, environment variables, or routing were changed.

project.deletion.rejected.label: App deletion refused
project.deletion.rejected.description: A delete was refused — something still depends on this app.

project.deletion.failed.label: App deletion failed
project.deletion.failed.description: Cleanup did not complete, so the app record was kept for a safe retry.

project.build_cache.cleared.label: Build cache cleared
project.build_cache.cleared.action: cleared the Docker build cache for
project.build_cache.cleared.description: Unused build cache was removed from the app's Docker host.

project:write.label: App changed
project:write.description: One of the app's write endpoints was invoked.

project:admin.label: App admin action
project:admin.description: A destructive app endpoint was invoked, such as delete or transfer.

project:service:write.label: Service changed
project:service:write.description: A service was created, updated, started, stopped, or restarted.

project:service:admin.label: Service admin action
project:service:admin.action: ran an admin action on a service in
project:service:admin.actionWithoutResource: ran an admin action on a service

job:write.label: Job changed
job:write.description: A scheduled or custom job was created, edited, run, or removed.

service.down.label: App went down
service.down.description: A container that should be running isn't — exited, dead, or OOM-killed.

service.crash_loop.label: App is crash looping
service.crash_loop.description: A container keeps restarting instead of staying up.

service.unhealthy.label: App is unhealthy
service.unhealthy.description: A container is running but its own healthcheck is failing.

service.recovered.label: App recovered
service.recovered.description: An outage ended and the container is healthy again.

service.exec.label: Command executed in container
service.exec.description: A shell command was run inside a service's container. The command is recorded; its output is not, because output is unbounded and may contain secrets the command read.

domain.verified.label: Domain verified
domain.verified.description: DNS verification succeeded, so the domain can be issued a certificate.

domain.verification_failed.label: Domain verification failed
domain.verification_failed.description: DNS records for this domain don't point here yet.

domain.verify_failed.label: Domain verification failed
domain.verify_failed.description: DNS records for this domain don't point here yet.

domain.set_primary.label: Primary domain changed
domain.set_primary.description: The domain other addresses now redirect to.

domain.dns_provisioned.label: DNS records provisioned
domain.dns_provisioned.description: Openship wrote this domain's records at the connected DNS provider. The counts of applied and failed records are in the details.

domain.cert_uploaded.label: Certificate uploaded
domain.cert_uploaded.description: A certificate and key were supplied by hand instead of issued automatically.

ssl.renewal_failed.label: SSL renewal failed
ssl.renewal_failed.description: Automatic renewal failed — the certificate will expire unless this is fixed.

credential.created.label: Credential added
credential.created.description: A credential for a third-party service (a registry login, a DNS token) was stored. The secret itself is never recorded.

credential.updated.label: Credential updated
credential.updated.description: A stored credential's label, scope or secret was changed. Neither the old nor the new secret is recorded.

credential.deleted.label: Credential deleted
credential.deleted.description: A stored credential was removed. Anything relying on it — a private image pull, a DNS record write — stops working until another is added.

credential.verified.label: Credential verified
credential.verified.description: Openship asked the provider whether a stored credential still works.

dns_credential.connected.label: DNS provider connected
dns_credential.connected.description: An API token that lets Openship write this organization's DNS records was stored. The token itself is never recorded.

dns_credential.disconnected.label: DNS provider disconnected
dns_credential.disconnected.description: Openship can no longer write DNS records for domains in that provider's zones; records already written are left in place.

domain:write.label: Domain action
domain:write.description: A domain endpoint was invoked — add, verify, or renew.

domain:admin.label: Domain admin action
domain:admin.action: ran an admin action on the domain

server.removal.rejected.label: Server removal refused
server.removal.rejected.description: A removal was refused because a workload could not be torn down, or was destroyed but left a resource behind for cleanup. The server row was kept so those resources can still be reclaimed.

server.exec.label: Command executed
server.exec.action: ran a command on the server
server.exec.description: A shell command was run on the host. The command is recorded; its output is not, because output is unbounded and may contain secrets the command read.

server.unreachable.label: Server unreachable
server.unreachable.description: Openship could not open an SSH connection to this server.

migration.source_connected.label: Migration source connected
migration.source_connected.description: An external SSH server was connected for importing projects. It cannot be used as a deployment destination.

migration.source_disconnected.label: Migration source disconnected
migration.source_disconnected.description: The stored migration connection was removed. The source server and its data are unchanged.

server:admin.label: Server admin action
server:admin.action: ran an admin action on the server
server:admin.description: A destructive server endpoint was invoked, such as delete or component install.

terminal:write.label: Terminal session opened
terminal:write.description: An interactive shell session was issued against a server.

mail_server:write.label: Mail server changed
mail_server:write.description: A mail server endpoint was invoked — setup, domain, DNS acknowledgement.

mail_server:admin.label: Mail server admin action
mail_server:admin.action: ran an admin action on the mail server

mail.inbound_received.label: Mail arrived at a watched address
mail.inbound_received.action: received mail matching a notification rule on
mail.inbound_received.actionWithoutResource: received mail matching a notification rule

identity.provisioned.label: Identity provisioned
identity.provisioned.description: A trusted host mapped an external identity to an Openship user.

organization.deletion.blocked.label: Organization deletion blocked
organization.deletion.blocked.description: Deletion was refused — active resources or billing still attached.

member.updated.label: Membership updated by the host
member.updated.description: A trusted host added, changed or removed an organization membership.

member.joined.label: Member joined
member.joined.description: An invitee accepted and now has access.

member.removal.grant_cleanup_failed.label: Removed member's permissions not cleaned up
member.removal.grant_cleanup_failed.description: The member is gone but their permission grants remained — review by hand.

member.removal.subscription_cleanup_fail.label: Removed member's billing not cleaned up
member.removal.subscription_cleanup_fail.description: The member is gone but a linked subscription remained — review billing.

invitation.sent.label: Invitation sent with pending permissions
invitation.sent.description: Grants were queued and will apply the moment the invitee joins.

invitation.resent.label: Invitation renewed
invitation.resent.description: The invitation's authority and expiry were renewed; delivery may use email or a link.

grant.replaced.label: Permission replaced
grant.replaced.description: An existing grant was overwritten with a different scope.

mcp.authorized.label: MCP client authorized
mcp.authorized.description: An AI agent was connected and given a scope to act within.

mcp.scope_changed.label: MCP access changed
mcp.scope_changed.action: changed the access of the MCP client
mcp.scope_changed.description: A connected agent's scope was edited. It takes effect on the agent's next request — no reconnect.

mcp.disconnected.label: MCP client disconnected
mcp.disconnected.description: A connected agent's tokens, consent and scope were torn down. It stops working immediately and must re-consent to return.

mcp.tool_called.label: Agent tool call
mcp.tool_called.description: A tool call that left no other trace: a read, or an attempt that was refused or errored. A tool call that successfully changed something is recorded as the change itself, so it is not duplicated here.

grant.materialized.label: Pending permission applied
grant.materialized.description: A grant attached to an invitation was applied once the invitee joined.

permissions:admin.label: Permissions admin action
permissions:admin.action: ran an admin action on permissions for
permissions:admin.actionWithoutResource: ran an admin action on permissions

admin.bootstrapped.label: First admin account created
admin.bootstrapped.description: The instance's initial owner was created — this can only happen once.

auth-mode-changed.label: Sign-in mode changed
auth-mode-changed.description: The instance switched between single-user and full authentication.

instance.data.exported.label: Instance data exported
instance.data.exported.description: A full database dump left this instance.

instance.data.receive_code_created.label: Data-transfer receive code created
instance.data.receive_code_created.action: created a direct data-transfer receive code
instance.data.receive_code_created.description: A short-lived code was created to receive instance data directly.

instance.data.sent.label: Instance data sent
instance.data.sent.action: sent instance data to another instance
instance.data.sent.description: Selected instance data was transferred directly to another instance.

instance.data.imported.label: Instance data imported
instance.data.imported.description: A database dump from another instance was loaded in.

instance.move_requested.label: Control-plane move requested
instance.move_requested.action: requested a control-plane move to another instance
instance.move_requested.description: An administrator requested a transfer of instance data and control to another instance.

instance.server_move_requested.label: Server control-plane move requested
instance.server_move_requested.action: requested a control-plane move to a server
instance.server_move_requested.description: An administrator requested a hosted control plane on a selected server.

audit.disabled.label: Activity recording turned off
audit.disabled.description: No further actions were recorded until recording was turned back on.

audit.retention_changed.label: Activity retention changed
audit.retention_changed.action: changed how long activity is kept

billing.hard_cap_tripped.label: Spending cap reached
billing.hard_cap_tripped.description: Cloud resources may have been paused — review billing.

billing.credit_low.label: Cloud credits running low
billing.credit_low.description: Review the remaining allowance before Cloud workloads are interrupted.

billing.credit_exhausted.label: Credits exhausted
billing.credit_exhausted.description: Metered usage is paused until a top-up or the monthly reset.

billing:write.label: Billing action
billing:write.description: A billing endpoint was invoked — subscribe, top up, or open the portal.

billing:admin.label: Billing admin action
billing:admin.action: ran an admin action on billing for
billing:admin.description: A destructive billing endpoint was invoked, such as cancelling a subscription.
billing:admin.actionWithoutResource: ran an admin action on billing

settings:admin.label: Settings admin action
settings:admin.action: ran an admin action on settings
settings:admin.description: A destructive settings endpoint was invoked, such as a wipe or migration.

updates:write.label: Update applied
updates:write.description: An Openship component was updated or an update scan was triggered.

cloud:write.label: Cloud action
cloud:write.description: A cloud bridge endpoint was invoked — token, preflight, or edge proxy.

github.source.created.label: GitHub App source registered
github.source.created.description: An organization-owned GitHub App was verified and stored. Secret values are never recorded.

github.source.updated.label: GitHub App source updated
github.source.updated.description: A GitHub App's identity, endpoint, or encrypted credentials changed.

github.source.defaulted.label: Default GitHub App source changed
github.source.defaulted.action: made the default GitHub App source

github.source.deleted.label: GitHub App source deleted
github.source.deleted.description: The local App credentials and installation bindings were removed; the GitHub App itself was not uninstalled on GitHub.

github.instance_token.set.label: Instance GitHub token set
github.instance_token.set.description: A GitHub token shared by every project on this instance was stored.

github:admin.label: GitHub admin action
github:admin.action: ran a GitHub admin action on

backup.webhook.disabled.label: Backup webhook disabled
backup.webhook.disabled.description: The webhook failed too many times and was switched off.

backup_destination:admin.label: Backup destination admin action
backup_destination:admin.action: ran an admin action on the backup destination
